item.title: US Supreme Court rejects Trump mail ballot restrictions for midterms
item.description: The US Supreme Court on Monday rejected President Donald Trump’s bid to restrict mail ballots for the midterm elections, capping a flurry of last-minute legal action with voting already under way. The decision allows states to continue sending out mail ballots under the same processes they’ve used for years. Justices Samuel Alito and Clarence Thomas publicly dissented from the brief order. The Trump administration had asked the court, once again at the centre of a roiling political controversy,... Fuente: South China Morning Post.

item.description: The unique circumstances surrounding Huawei Technologies’ landmark trial in a US court made jury selection especially important to ensuring a fair trial for the Chinese tech giant, according to US litigation experts. item.title: ¿Puede frenarse el desarrollo de la IA sin el apoyo del Gobierno de Donald Trump?
item.description: Donald Trump rechazó los llamados a frenar el desarrollo de la inteligencia artificial, calificando las advertencias de “fuerzas negativas” y denunciando una supuesta conspiración que, según él, solo beneficiaría a China. Su postura contrasta con la de líderes tecnológicos que piden ralentizar su avance para mitigar riesgos. Rodolfo Tesone, abogado especialista en inteligencia artificial (IA), presidente emérito y fundador de ENATIC (Asociación Española de la Abogacía y el Derecho Digital), aborda el tema en France 24. item.title: 'The very existence of LGBTQI people is seen as obscene', Turkish activist says
item.description: Turkish police on Sunday swooped on gay bars and the homes of LGBTQ activists, arresting at least 60 people in raids authorities said were aimed at boosting traditional family values, officials and activists said. Turkey's LGBTQ community has frequently been targeted by the government, with President Recep Tayyip Erdogan lashing it as a "deviant movement" of "perverts" responsible for the falling birth rate. item.description: Israel's upcoming election could be one of the most consequential in the country's history, with Benjamin Netanyahu's own former military chief firming as the favourite to oust the prime minister from office. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Second federal judge freezes Trump mail ballot order with U.S. Supreme Court poised to weigh in
item.description: A federal judge in Washington, D.C. has issued a new order freezing President Donald Trump’s attempt to limit mail voting for the midterm elections Fuente: The Hindu - International.

item.title: Pauline Hanson’s comments about Indigenous Australians condemned as ‘nasty’ and ‘derogatory’
item.description: Indigenous senators have criticised One Nation leader saying the comments showed ‘wilful ignorance’ Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our new political email , free app or daily news podcast Federal parliamentarians from across the political spectrum have joined in condemning resurfaced comments by Pauline Hanson as “nasty” and “derogatory”, after she labelled Indigenous Australians the “most primitive race on Earth”. The Indigenous affairs minister, Malarndirri McCarthy, a Yanyuwa and Garrwa woman, described the One Nation senator’s comments as “totally outrageous”… Fuente: The Guardian - World.

item.title: Swedish left-wing bloc edges ahead in knife-edge election results
item.description: Final results are not expected before Wednesday, when local election boards count postal votes that arrived too late for polling day, along with ballots cast from abroad Fuente: The Independent - World.
